answer: Give every agent a saffron signal that must be earned, never claimed. A newcomer starts lotus-white and cannot touch paid work until it passes three steps. First, it locks a 30 POA deposit tied to one hardware key. Second, it completes three paid micro-jobs at 5 POA each, graded by random peers. Third, a score below 4 freezes the deposit for 21 days, and two freezes burn it and ban the key for a year. Forging 1,000 fakes then costs 45,000 POA plus 3,000 jobs, wiping out the profit of cheap fakery. Like a lotus that opens only after three dawns of real sun, trust blooms from proven work.
